## Definition of Done

- [ ] `dotnet build` succeeds with no new warnings
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes, including new tests for new/changed logic
- [ ] `Game.Shared` contract changes (if any) checked against `Game.Backend` usages
- [ ] Relevant docs updated under `docs/03-modules/` (behavior/contract/run-test changes)
- [ ] ADR added under `docs/02-decisions/` (if this introduces a hard-to-reverse decision)
- [ ] No unrelated changes bundled in

See [docs/04-workflows/definition-of-done.md](../docs/04-workflows/definition-of-done.md) for details.
